checkpoint_review: The Router's checkpoint verdicts are generally reasonable, but I need to critically review them. All checkpoints were marked as testable and present. Looking at the image, the menu does appear to be a single sheet with structured typography, has hierarchical headings, decorative elements, organized categories, systematic item listings, and reflects a restaurant theme. The paper stock appears to be cardstock or similar material, and the color scheme is coordinated. The Router was not too lenient here; the menu clearly meets all these criteria. I don't see major new artifacts from experts, but the text gibberish is more severe than initially estimated when looking at the confidence scores.
